title: LLMs as Strategic Actors: Behavioral Alignment, Risk Calibration, and Argumentation Framing in Geopolitical Simulations
reasoning: The paper evaluates the 'normative-cooperative' framing of LLMs, which includes specific assessment categories for humanitarian protection, democratic values, and climate justice. It examines whether models justify strategic decisions using ethical and value-based reasoning rather than purely instrumental or adversarial logic.
